title: System Wizard – AI-Powered Shell Script Generator
overview: A demonstration of the System Wizard application within Cognotik, which uses an LLM to generate and execute shell scripts based on natural language goals. The demo shows entering a goal ('list running processes'), configuring settings, generating a PowerShell script, and running it with auto-fix capability.
